name: @peerwheel/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Peerwheel (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && pnpm run bundle:yaml && pnpm run bundle:json
scripts.bundle:yaml: redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle vehicles --output src/.bundled/vehicles.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle rides --output src/.bundled/rides.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle attestations --output src/.bundled/attestations.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle settlements --output src/.bundled/settlements.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle disputes --output src/.bundled/disputes.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle canvas --output src/.bundled/canvas.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle corridors --output src/.bundled/corridors.openapi.yaml
scripts.bundle:json: redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle vehicles --output src/.bundled/vehicles.json && redocly bundle rides --output src/.bundled/rides.json && redocly bundle attestations --output src/.bundled/attestations.json && redocly bundle settlements --output src/.bundled/settlements.json && redocly bundle disputes --output src/.bundled/disputes.json && redocly bundle canvas --output src/.bundled/canvas.json && redocly bundle corridors --output src/.bundled/corridors.json
